raw: {"analysis": "HGN provides a detailed plan with clear gates, rollback, and deployment strategy, but its description of the kill switch logic—checking model service latency/error rates before attempting a model call—could violate the core requirement of independence from the model service, as it would rely on the model to decide when to switch. SGN explicitly proposes an independent health check (e.g., local flag or separate endpoint) and emphasizes not depending on the model service, which correctly addresses the key constraint. Both handle local testing, CI cost, schema immutability, and approval gates well, but SGN is more accurate on the critical independence requirement and avoids a potential design flaw.", "verdict": "SGN"}
